welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.intro: I am Lumee, your digital companion in the emergency department.
welcome.description: I am here to help you make the best use of your waiting time. Together, we can prepare for your doctor's visit by asking about your condition. I can also answer your questions about the process and provide a map for orientation.
welcome.lookForward: Set your default settings here first:

step1.title: Customize Lumee
step1.description: Adjust your settings at any time for an experience that fits your needs.

step2.title: Chat with Lumee
step2.description:
Lumee listens, responds with empathy, and supports you during your waiting time. You can ask general questions about the emergency department, such as:

"How does the emergency room process work?"

"Where is the nearest restroom?"

step3.title: Symptom Intake Made Easy
step3.description:
In addition to general information, Lumee can also help you record your symptoms step by step.

Select the type of pain, the affected body area, the intensity, and the duration.

You can also add allergies, medications, and your medical history.

Lumee does not provide diagnoses — but Lumee supports, reassures, and explains.

step4.title: Your Symptom Overview
step4.description: Keep track of your current symptoms and complete your medical history — all in one place.

step5.title: Your data at Lumee
bulletPoints: Health data may be processed (special data according to Art. 9 DSGVO).
Use is voluntary. If you do not consent, you can provide your information directly to the staff.
Data is transmitted and stored in encrypted form.
Only necessary data is collected and stored only as long as required.
If external AI/LLM services are used: Data is transmitted pseudonymized and not used for training.
imageCaptions:
Lumee is optional
Declining the Privacy policy does not affect your waiting time or the of your care.
Your data can only be viewed by authorized medical personnel.
We only store information that is strictly necessary for your medical care.
Data is encrypted during transmission and storage and only kept as long as necessary.
step5.mandatoryConsent: I expressly consent that [Hospital Name] processes my information including health data for treatment preparation and makes it available to medical staff. (Art. 9 Abs. 2 lit. a DSGVO)
step5.optionalConsent: I additionally consent that my information may be used pseudonymized for quality/statistics/research. (Art. 9 Abs. 2 lit. j DSGVO)
step5.detailsText:
Here you can insert your detailed privacy information. This should include all relevant information about data processing, storage, sharing, and your rights.

You can customize this text in the file src/i18n/locales/en.json under walkthrough.step5.detailsText.

step6.title: No problem — we are here for you!
step6.description: You have chosen not to use Lumee. That is perfectly fine. Please wait in the seating area until your name is called.
step6.important: Important: If your condition worsens, please contact the hospital staff immediately.
